rawFindings.title: Incorrect behavior change in 'curly' rule for 'multi-or-nest' option
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces the assignment to 'expected' for 'multi-or-nest' option from being true if the single statement in the block has leading comments, to always being false. This removes the special handling where a block with a single nested statement and leading comments required braces. This alters the rule behavior and can cause correct warnings to stop appearing.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore original assignment by replacing 'expected = false;' with 'const leadingComments = sourceCode.getComments(body.body[0]).leading; expected = leadingComments.length > 0;' in the affected line.
